value.title: Set up procedures in a repo
value.summary: Set a repo up for procedures: copy the schema, make the home, add the `proc` and `procedures-check` recipes, ignore run progress, write a first procedure and pass the drift check. Every step is idempotent.

value.who: The seat adopting procedures in a project (its prime, PM or docs role).
value.when: Once per repo, when a project starts writing procedures. Run it from the target repo: `pij proc PROC-meta-0002 <step>`.

value.text: the repo is a git checkout on a branch other than main
value.fix: make a feature branch (ideally its own worktree) and run again from there

value.title: Copy the pij/procedure schema
value.done_when: The repo's `.dd/schemas/pij/procedure/schema.json` matches the skill's copy, so `ddocs validate` reads procedure documents.

value.title: Add the `proc` and `procedures-check` recipes
value.done_when: The root justfile has both recipes, each calling `pij proc`.

value.title: Ignore run progress
value.done_when: `.pij/` is in `.gitignore`, so per-checkout progress is never committed.

value.title: Write the first procedure
value.done_when: The repo has one procedure, written by following PROC-meta-0001.

value.title: Pass the drift check
value.done_when: `just procedures-check` is clean; add it to the repo's gate (its `self-check` or CI).

sections.name: done_when
sections.value: The repo validates and checks procedures, ignores run progress, and has a first procedure that passes the drift check. Running every step again changes nothing.

value.text: It adds recipes to the root justfile only when that file has no `proc` recipe; a repo with its own `proc` keeps it.
The repo still needs `ddocs` and `pij` on PATH; this procedure does not install them.
Running it from the pij skill's folder instead of the target repo: every step works on the repo you run it from.

value.guarantees: Setting up procedures in a repo is this procedure, with the schema it copies kept in the skill.

value.why: The schema step 0001 copies; shared with the skill's other doc schemas.
Step 0001 writes the schema into the target repo.
Step 0003 appends the proc and procedures-check recipes.
